raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

DSpark walks its draft block left to right: each step adds `W2 @ W1[prev]` to the base logits (W2 is V x 256) and then takes the argmax or a sample. Today every draft token is a full-vocab GEMV, an add and a sampler, and W2 (78 MB in bf16 at V = 151936) is read from HBM again on every step.

This adds `dspark_markov_quantization="int8"` to the speculative config. With it, sm_90 runs the whole walk in one cooperative kernel. W2 is quantized to int8 with one fp32 scale per row, most of it stays in shared memory across all SMs and the rest streams from L2, and the per-step argmax across CTAs goes through one atomic {key, count} pair. Off by default.

The kernel is adapted from the MIT-licensed int8 Markov walk kernels in https://github.com/tie-pilot-qxw/dspark-markov-walk (notice kept in `csrc/dspark_markov_walk.cu`).

## Claims

- Markov walk on 1x H100, eager loop vs this kernel: 298 -> 60 us at V = 151936 with 7 draft tokens (bs 1, greedy), 431 -> 68 us at bs 16, 563 -> 112 us at bs 64. 3.4-6.3x across the table below.
- Qwen3-4B on 1x H100, output tok/s over the eager loop: +4.3% at c1 and +4.6% at c16 with the 7-token DSpark drafter (greedy), +9.3% and +8.8% with the 16-token one. Probabilistic at c1: +5.5% and +11.7%.
- Greedy outputs at c1 match the eager walk (80/80). Acceptance length moves by at most 0.06 tokens and GSM8K by at most 0.025 on these prompts.

## Validation

All on 1x H100 at 5af18a75ec. The one later commit only changes how the launch sets its shared memory attribute, and the kernel tests pass on it too.

Kernel (`python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_dspark_markov_walk.py`, CUPTI, CUDA graph, cold L2, median us per call for all draft steps). The eager arm is `_sample_sequential`'s loop, with `greedy_argmax` and `gumbel_sample`:

| V | draft tokens | bs | greedy eager -> int8 | probabilistic eager -> int8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 151936 | 7 | 1 | 298.2 -> 60.5 (4.93x) | 356.2 -> 80.9 (4.40x) |
| 151936 | 7 | 16 | 431.0 -> 68.0 (6.34x) | 563.1 -> 91.4 (6.16x) |
| 151936 | 7 | 64 | 563.2 -> 112.3 (5.01x) | 878.6 -> 179.8 (4.89x) |
| 151936 | 16 | 1 | 682.7 -> 124.9 (5.47x) | 819.0 -> 172.4 (4.75x) |
| 129280 | 5 | 1 | 198.6 -> 41.8 (4.75x) | 237.5 -> 54.8 (4.33x) |
| 129280 | 5 | 64 | 341.6 -> 77.1 (4.43x) | 535.4 -> 114.3 (4.69x) |
| 248320 | 16 | 1 | 959.2 -> 270.3 (3.55x) | 1099.9 -> 324.6 (3.39x) |

e2e, Qwen3-4B, GSM8K prompts (80 at c1, 320 at c16, max 512 tokens), eager and int8 arms interleaved, 2 runs each in a fresh process (runs of an arm within 0.7%), mean output tok/s:

| drafter | setting | eager | int8 | accept len eager / int8 | GSM8K eager / int8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_4b_block7 (7) | greedy c1 | 1031 | 1076 (+4.3%) | 6.255 / 6.253 | 0.850 / 0.850 |
| | greedy c16 | 13047 | 13651 (+4.6%) | 6.351 / 6.369 | 0.834 / 0.816 |
| | probabilistic c1 | 1012 | 1069 (+5.5%) | 6.214 / 6.246 | 0.813 / 0.838 |
| shreybirmiwal/Qwen3-4B-DSpark-b16 (16) | greedy c1 | 1057 | 1155 (+9.3%) | 7.046 / 7.041 | 0.850 / 0.850 |
| | greedy c16 | 12046 | 13111 (+8.8%) | 7.226 / 7.239 | 0.822 / 0.828 |
| | probabilistic c1 | 1015 | 1133 (+11.7%) | 6.918 / 6.975 | 0.800 / 0.813 |

Tests:
- `pytest tests/kernels/test_dspark_markov_walk.py`: 66 passed.
- `pytest "tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/dspark/test_dspark.py::test_dspark_correctness_and_acceptance_rate[qwen3-deepspec-int8-walk]"` with `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`: passed (GSM8K 0.791, acceptance length 4.009; the stock `qwen3-deepspec` case in the same run: 0.778, 4.011).

## Details

- Only acceptance can change. int8 W2 can move near-ties, and the target still verifies every draft token. For probabilistic drafting the kernel writes the bf16 logits it sampled from into `draft_logits`, so rejection sampling uses exactly that distribution.
- Sampling noise is Philox keyed by the request seed and the draft position, so seeded requests stay reproducible. A seed draws different tokens than it does with the eager loop.
- TP: every rank runs the whole walk, so with this option the draft logits cache stays replicated and the sequential sampling is not batch-sharded. I only ran it at TP1.
- Supported: sm_90, vanilla Markov head with rank 256 in bf16, fp16 or fp32, full-vocab drafts, up to 16 draft tokens, V up to 270336 on 132 SMs, bs <= 64 (larger batches keep the eager loop). Loading fails with a clear error for draft watermarking, the online acceptance estimator, a logit soft cap or output logit transform, a draft model with its own `sample_sequential`, `dspark_draft_topk`, or a quantized W2.
- Memory: 114 MiB of int8 layouts at V = 151936.
- CI: the kernel test runs on H100. The new `qwen3-deepspec-int8-walk` case skips on GPUs with too few SMs to hold W2 (e.g. a MIG slice), so I ran it on a full H100 (above).
- Not a duplicate: #61869 fuses the Markov loop for DeepSeek-V4.1's specialized decode on GB300. #64442 fuses it for DeepSeek-V4.1 on NVIDIA by inverse CDF, with a bias GEMM per step. #64476 adds the bias inside the Gumbel kernel, also with a GEMV per step, so if it lands first the probabilistic eager column needs a re-measure. #65007 shards the walk over TP, #64033 is the top-k walk and #56694 prunes W2 with top-k. This PR is the generic DSpark path on Hopper with W2 kept on chip.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DSpark Markov walk: the eager per-step loop vs dspark_markov_walk (sm_90a).
+
+Both arms walk the same base logits. Times are per call (all draft steps),
+replayed from a CUDA graph with a cold L2 cache.
+"""
+
+from functools import partial
+from statistics import median
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.utils.argparse_utils import FlexibleArgumentParser
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.greedy_argmax import greedy_argmax
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.gumbel import gumbel_sample
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dspark.markov_walk import DSparkMarkovWalker
+
+
+def eager_walk(
+    w1, w2, base, anchor, tokens, idx, temperature, seeds, pos, draft_logits, cols
+):
+    """The loop of DSparkSpeculator._sample_sequential (full vocabulary)."""
+    prev = anchor
+    for i in range(base.shape[1]):
+        logits = base[:, i] + F.linear(F.embedding(prev, w1), w2)
+        if draft_logits is None:
+            tok = greedy_argmax(logits)
+        else:
+            tok = gumbel_sample(
+                logits,
+                idx[:, i],
+                temperature,
+                seeds,
+                pos[:, i] - 1,
+                apply_temperature=True,
+                is_drafting=True,
+                logits_cache=draft_logits,
+                logits_cache_col=cols[i],
+            )
+        tokens[:, i] = tok
+        prev = tok
+
+
+def timer(method: str):
+    if method == "cupti":
+        from flashinfer.testing import bench_gpu_time_with_cupti
+
+        return partial(
+            bench_gpu_time_with_cupti, use_cuda_graph=True, cold_l2_cache=True
+        )
+    from flashinfer.testing import bench_gpu_time_with_cudagraph
+
+    return partial(bench_gpu_time_with_cudagraph, cold_l2_cache=True)
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def main(args) -> None:
+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    bench = timer(args.timer)
+    print("vocab steps batch mode | eager_us fused_us speedup | eager W2 GB/s")
+    for vocab in args.vocab:
+        g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(0)
+        w1 = (torch.randn(vocab, 256, generator=g, device=device) * 0.05).bfloat16()
+        w2 = (torch.randn(vocab, 256, generator=g, device=device) * 0.02).bfloat16()
+        for steps in args.steps:
+            walker = DSparkMarkovWalker(w1, w2, steps)
+            walker.warmup()
+            max_reqs = max(args.batch)
+            draft_logits = torch.zeros(
+                max_reqs, steps, vocab, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+            )
+            temperature = torch.ones(max_reqs, device=device)
+            seeds = torch.arange(max_reqs, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+            cols = torch.arange(steps, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+            for batch in args.batch:
+                base = (
+                    torch.randn(batch, steps, vocab, generator=g, device=device) * 3
+                ).bfloat16()
+                anchor = torch.randint(0, vocab, (batch,), generator=g, device=device)
+                anchor_ids = anchor.int()
+                idx = (
+                    torch.arange(batch, device=device)[:, None]
+                    .expand(batch, steps)
+                    .contiguous()
+                )
+                pos = torch.arange(batch * steps, device=device).view(batch, steps) + 1
+                tokens = torch.empty(batch, steps, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+                for mode in args.mode:
+                    cache = draft_logits if mode == "probabilistic" else None
+                    temp = temperature if mode == "probabilistic" else None
+
+                    run_eager = partial(
+                        eager_walk,
+                        w1,
+                        w2,
+                        base,
+                        anchor,
+                        tokens,
+                        idx,
+                        temperature,
+                        seeds,
+                        pos,
+                        cache,
+                        cols,
+                    )
+                    run_fused = partial(
+                        walker.walk,
+                        base,
+                        anchor_ids,
+                        1,
+                        idx.view(-1),
+                        temp,
+                        seeds,
+                        pos.view(-1),
+                        tokens,
+                        cache,
+                    )
+                    eager_us = median(bench(run_eager)) * 1e3
+                    fused_us = median(bench(run_fused)) * 1e3
+                    gbps = steps * vocab * 256 * 2 / (eager_us * 1e3)
+                    print(
+                        f"{vocab} {steps} {batch} {mode} | {eager_us:.1f} "
+                        f"{fused_us:.1f} {eager_us / fused_us:.2f}x | "
+                        f"{gbps:.0f}"
+                    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = FlexibleArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--vocab", type=int, nargs="+", default=[151936, 129280, 248320]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, nargs="+", default=[5, 7, 16])
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--batch", type=int, nargs="+", default=[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--mode",
+        nargs="+",
+        default=["greedy", "probabilistic"],
+        choices=["greedy", "probabilistic"],
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--timer", default="cupti", choices=["cupti", "cudagraph"])
+    main(parser.parse_args())

@@ -0,0 +1,236 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""dspark_markov_walk against an exact replay of its int8 arithmetic.
+
+The kernel's dot products are exact int32 sums, so a float64 replay of the
+same quantized operands and fp32 roundings reproduces its bf16 logits bit for
+bit (up to double rounding in the final fma, which random data never hits).
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dspark.markov_walk import (
+    STATE_NUMEL,
+    DSparkMarkovWalker,
+    pick_tiles,
+    quantize_w1,
+    quantize_w2,
+    unsupported_reason,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda()
+    or not current_platform.is_device_capability(90)
+    or not hasattr(torch.ops._C, "dspark_markov_walk"),
+    reason="dspark_markov_walk needs an sm_90 build",
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+RANK = 256
+
+
+def make_head(vocab: int, seed: int = 0):
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    w1 = (torch.randn(vocab, RANK, generator=g, device=DEVICE) * 0.05).bfloat16()
+    w2 = (torch.randn(vocab, RANK, generator=g, device=DEVICE) * 0.02).bfloat16()
+    return w1, w2
+
+
+class Reference:
+    """Float64 replay of the kernel's numerics."""
+
+    def __init__(self, w1, w2, logit_scale=1.0):
+        q_w2, self.row_scale = quantize_w2(w2, logit_scale)
+        self.q_w2 = q_w2.double()
+        q_hi, q_lo, _, self.s_lo = quantize_w1(w1)
+        self.q_hi, self.q_lo = q_hi.double(), q_lo.double()
+
+    def logits(self, base_k: torch.Tensor, prev: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """bf16 [n, V] logits of one step from base [n, V] and prev [n]."""
+        d_hi = self.q_hi[prev] @ self.q_w2.T
+        d_lo = self.q_lo[prev] @ self.q_w2.T
+        combined = (d_hi * 256 + d_lo).long().float().double()
+        bias = (self.s_lo[prev].double()[:, None] * combined).float().double()
+        logit = self.row_scale.double()[None] * bias + base_k.double()
+        return logit.float().bfloat16()
+
+
+def run_walk(
+    walker,
+    base,
+    anchor,
+    *,
+    temps=None,
+    seeds=None,
+    pos=None,
+    idx=None,
+    draft_logits=None,
+    tokens=None,
+):
+    nb, steps, _ = base.shape

+    if seeds is None:
+        seeds = torch.arange(nb, dtype=torch.int64, device=DEVICE) + 1234
+    if pos is None:
+        pos = torch.arange(nb * steps, dtype=torch.int64, device=DEVICE)
+    if tokens is None:
+        tokens = torch.full((nb, steps), -1, dtype=torch.int64, device=DEVICE)

+def test_logit_scale_folds_into_the_bias():

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_reqs", [1, 40])
+def test_draft_logits_cache(num_reqs):
+    """Sampled requests cache the exact logits they drew from; greedy and
+    padding requests leave their rows alone."""
+    vocab, steps, max_reqs = 151936, 7, 128
+    w1, w2 = make_head(vocab, seed=2)
+    walker = DSparkMarkovWalker(w1, w2, steps)
+    ref = Reference(w1, w2)
+    base = (torch.randn(num_reqs, steps, vocab, device=DEVICE) * 3).bfloat16()
+    anchor = torch.randint(0, vocab, (num_reqs,), device=DEVICE)
+    # request b lives in state slot 2b + 1; every third one is greedy, the
+    # last one is a padding row
+    slots = torch.arange(num_reqs, device=DEVICE) * 2 + 1
+    slots[-1] = -1
+    idx = slots.repeat_interleave(steps)
+    temperature = torch.zeros(max_reqs, device=DEVICE)
+    temperature[slots[slots >= 0]] = 0.8
+    temperature[slots[::3][slots[::3] >= 0]] = 0.0
+    sentinel = 7.0
+    cache = torch.full(
+        (max_reqs, steps, vocab), sentinel, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE
+    )
+    seeds = torch.randint(0, 2**62, (max_reqs,), device=DEVICE)
+    tokens = run_walk(
+        walker,
+        base,
+        anchor,
+        temps=temperature,
+        seeds=seeds,
+        idx=idx,
+        draft_logits=cache,
+    )
+
+    assert ((tokens >= 0) & (tokens < vocab)).all()
+    prev = anchor
+    for k in range(steps):
+        expected = ref.logits(base[:, k], prev)
+        for b in range(num_reqs):
+            slot = int(slots[b])
+            sampled = slot >= 0 and float(temperature[slot]) > 0
+            if sampled:
+                assert torch.equal(cache[slot, k], expected[b])
+            elif slot >= 0:
+                assert (cache[slot, k] == sentinel).all()
+            if not sampled:  # greedy and padding rows take the argmax
+                assert int(tokens[b, k]) == int(expected[b].argmax())
+        prev = tokens[:, k]
+    untouched = torch.ones(max_reqs, dtype=torch.bool, device=DEVICE)
+    untouched[slots[slots >= 0]] = False
+    assert (cache[untouched] == sentinel).all()
+

+def test_sampling_is_seeded_and_distributed():
+    vocab, steps = 4096, 1
+    w1 = torch.randn(vocab, RANK, device=DEVICE).bfloat16()
+    w2 = torch.zeros(vocab, RANK, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)  # no bias
+    walker = DSparkMarkovWalker(w1, w2, steps)
+    logits = torch.full((vocab,), -30.0, device=DEVICE)
+    hot = torch.tensor([5, 77, 1000, 1001, 2047, 4095], device=DEVICE)
+    logits[hot] = torch.tensor([1.0, 0.5, 0.0, -0.5, 0.25, 0.75], device=DEVICE)
+    base = logits.bfloat16().view(1, 1, vocab)
+    temperature = torch.tensor([0.9], device=DEVICE)
+    probs = torch.softmax(base.float().view(-1) / 0.9, -1)[hot].double()
+
+    n = 6000
+    counts = torch.zeros(vocab, dtype=torch.int64, device=DEVICE)
+    first = None
+    for i in range(n):
+        tokens = run_walk(
+            walker,
+            base,
+            torch.zeros(1, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.long),
+            temps=temperature,
+            seeds=torch.tensor([42], device=DEVICE),
+            pos=torch.tensor([i], device=DEVICE),
+        )
+        counts[tokens.view(-1)] += 1
+        if i == 0:
+            first = tokens.clone()
+    assert int(counts[hot].sum()) == n
+    # the same (seed, position) replays the same draw
+    again = run_walk(
+        walker,
+        base,
+        torch.zeros(1, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.long),
+        temps=temperature,
+        seeds=torch.tensor([42], device=DEVICE),
+        pos=torch.tensor([0], device=DEVICE),
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(first, again)
+    expected = probs * n
+    chi2 = float((((counts[hot].double() - expected) ** 2) / expected).sum())
+    assert chi2 < 30.0, (chi2, counts[hot].tolist(), expected.tolist())  # 5 dof
+

+def test_non_finite_rows_stay_in_range():
+    vocab, steps = 151936, 3
+    w1, w2 = make_head(vocab, seed=3)
+    walker = DSparkMarkovWalker(w1, w2, steps)
+    base = torch.randn(9, steps, vocab, device=DEVICE).bfloat16()
+    base[4] = float("nan")

+    tokens = run_walk(walker, base, torch.randint(0, vocab, (9,), device=DEVICE))
+    assert ((tokens >= 0) & (tokens < vocab)).all()
+    assert (tokens[7] == 0).all()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""One-launch DSpark Markov walk with an int8 Markov projection kept on chip.
+
+Host side of ``csrc/dspark_markov_walk.cu`` (layouts adapted from Xinwei
+Qiang's int8 DSpark Markov walk kernels, MIT License). The eager
+walk reads the whole ``V x 256`` projection W2 from HBM once per draft step.
+The kernel quantizes W2 to int8 with one fp32 scale per row, keeps most of it
+in shared memory across all SMs and streams the rest from L2, and runs all
+steps in one cooperative launch. The target model verifies every draft token,
+so the only effect of the quantization is on acceptance.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+MARKOV_RANK = 256
+# FP8 heads keep separate scales, so their stored values are not the weights.
+WEIGHT_DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32)
+MAX_STEPS = 16
+MAX_REQS = 64
+TILE_ROWS = 64
+W1_ROW_BYTES = 528
+STATE_NUMEL = 16 + 2 * MAX_STEPS * MAX_REQS * 16
+# Tiles per CTA built into the kernel; each keeps RES tiles in SMEM and
+# streams the others from L2 through a RING-slot ring.
+TILE_BUILDS = (16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 32)
+RES, RING = 11, 2
+# The timed stream mask of the 18-tile layout (V = 151936 on 132 SMs).
+MASK_18 = sum(1 << t for t in (1, 2, 4, 7, 9, 11, 14))
+
+# Tile row permutation: accumulator column n of a 64-row tile holds tile row
+# rho(n), so every thread owns two aligned 8-row runs.
+_RHO = [
+    (8 * ((n % 8) // 2) + 2 * (n // 8) + n % 2)
+    if n // 8 < 4
+    else (32 + 8 * ((n % 8) // 2) + 2 * (n // 8 - 4) + n % 2)
+    for n in range(64)
+]
+
+
+def unsupported_reason(
+    w1: torch.Tensor, w2: torch.Tensor, num_steps: int
+) -> str | None:
+    """Why the kernel cannot walk this Markov head, or None if it can."""
+    if not current_platform.is_cuda() or not current_platform.is_device_capability(90):
+        return "it needs an sm_90 GPU"
+    if not hasattr(torch.ops._C, "dspark_markov_walk"):
+        return "this build has no dspark_markov_walk kernel"
+    if w2.dim() != 2 or w2.shape[1] != MARKOV_RANK:
+        return f"it needs a rank-{MARKOV_RANK} Markov head"
+    if w1.shape != w2.shape:
+        return "it needs a full-vocabulary draft (no draft-to-target map)"
+    if w2.dtype not in WEIGHT_DTYPES or w1.dtype not in WEIGHT_DTYPES:
+        return "it needs an unquantized Markov projection"
+    if w2.shape[0] % 8 != 0:
+        return "it needs a vocabulary size divisible by 8"
+    if not 1 <= num_steps <= MAX_STEPS:
+        return f"it supports at most {MAX_STEPS} draft tokens"
+    if pick_tiles(w2.shape[0], _num_sms(w2.device)) is None:
+        return "the vocabulary is too large for this GPU"
+    return None
+
+
+def _num_sms(device: torch.device) -> int:
+    return current_platform.num_compute_units(device.index or 0)
+
+
+def pick_tiles(vocab_size: int, num_sms: int) -> int | None:
+    need = -(-vocab_size // (num_sms * TILE_ROWS))
+    return next((t for t in TILE_BUILDS if t >= need), None)
+
+
+def stream_mask(tiles: int) -> int:
+    """Which tiles stream from L2 (bit t), spread over the four warpgroups.
+
+    With one 32-request block, warpgroup p walks tiles p, p + 4, ...; residents
+    are shared in proportion to each warpgroup's tile count, the first RING
+    warpgroups of (1, 2, 3, 0) open on a streamed tile (they consume the ring
+    prefill) and the others on a resident one.
+    """
+    if tiles == 18:
+        return MASK_18
+    seqs = [list(range(p, tiles, 4)) for p in range(4)]
+    quota = [RES * len(sq) / tiles for sq in seqs]
+    res = [int(q) for q in quota]
+    for _ in range(RES - sum(res)):
+        parity = [res[0] + res[2], res[1] + res[3]]
+        p = max(
+            (p for p in range(4) if res[p] < len(seqs[p])),
+            key=lambda p: (round(quota[p] - res[p], 9), -parity[p % 2], -p),
+        )
+        res[p] += 1
+    starts_streamed = {(1, 2, 3, 0)[i] for i in range(min(RING, 4))}
+    mask = 0
+    for p, sq in enumerate(seqs):
+        n, nr = len(sq), res[p]
+        ns = n - nr
+        if p in starts_streamed:
+            pos = {i * n // ns for i in range(ns)} if ns else set()
+        else:
+            pos = set(range(n)) - ({i * n // nr for i in range(nr)} if nr else set())
+        for j in pos:
+            mask |= 1 << sq[j]
+    assert bin(mask).count("1") == tiles - RES and mask < (1 << tiles)
+    return mask
+
+
+def quantize_w2(w2: torch.Tensor, scale: float) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """int8 W2 with one fp32 scale per row; ``scale`` (the logit scale) folds in."""
+    w = w2.float()
+    row_scale = (w.abs().amax(1, keepdim=True) / 127.0).clamp_min(1e-30)
+    q = (w / row_scale).round().clamp(-127, 127).to(torch.int8)
+    return q, (row_scale.view(-1) * scale).contiguous()
+
+
+def quantize_w1(w1: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+    """U ~= s_hi * q_hi + s_lo * q_lo with the fixed ratio s_lo = s_hi / 256."""
+    u = w1.float()
+    s_hi = (u.abs().amax(1, keepdim=True) / 127.0).clamp_min(1e-30)
+    q_hi = (u / s_hi).round().clamp(-127, 127)
+    s_lo = s_hi / 256.0
+    q_lo = ((u - s_hi * q_hi) / s_lo).round().clamp(-127, 127)
+    return q_hi.to(torch.int8), q_lo.to(torch.int8), s_hi.view(-1), s_lo.view(-1)
+
+
+def build_w2_tiles(
+    q_w2: torch.Tensor, rows_pad: int, tiles: int, mask: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Per CTA, 64-row tiles as K-major wgmma B operands with permuted rows,
+    split into the resident and the streamed tiles (each [grid, n, 16384])."""
+    qp = torch.zeros(rows_pad, MARKOV_RANK, dtype=torch.int8, device=q_w2.device)
+    qp[: q_w2.shape[0]] = q_w2
+    num_tiles = rows_pad // TILE_ROWS
+    t = qp.view(num_tiles, TILE_ROWS, MARKOV_RANK)[:, _RHO]
+    # [tile][k32 chunk][8-column group][k16 core][column][16 B]
+    v = t.view(num_tiles, 8, 8, 8, 2, 16).permute(0, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5)
+    v = v.contiguous().view(num_tiles // tiles, tiles, TILE_ROWS * MARKOV_RANK)
+    streamed = torch.tensor(
+        [(mask >> i) & 1 for i in range(tiles)], dtype=torch.bool, device=qp.device
+    )
+    return v[:, ~streamed].contiguous(), v[:, streamed].contiguous()
+
+
+def build_w1_rows(q_hi, q_lo, s_hi, s_lo) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """W1 rows in A-fragment order: per k32 chunk j and lane tig,
+    q_hi[32j + 4tig ..] | q_lo[..] | q_hi[32j + 16 + 4tig ..] | q_lo[..],
+    then s_hi and s_lo as fp32 (528 B per row)."""
+    vocab = q_hi.shape[0]
+    hi = q_hi.view(vocab, 8, 2, 4, 4)
+    lo = q_lo.view(vocab, 8, 2, 4, 4)
+    frag = torch.stack([hi[:, :, 0], lo[:, :, 0], hi[:, :, 1], lo[:, :, 1]], dim=3)
+    rows = torch.zeros(vocab, W1_ROW_BYTES, dtype=torch.uint8, device=q_hi.device)
+    rows[:, :512] = frag.reshape(vocab, 512).view(torch.uint8)
+    rows[:, 512:520] = torch.stack([s_hi, s_lo], 1).contiguous().view(torch.uint8)
+    return rows
+
+
+class DSparkMarkovWalker:
+    """int8 layouts of one Markov head and the kernel's persistent state."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        markov_w1: torch.Tensor,
+        markov_w2: torch.Tensor,
+        num_steps: int,
+        logit_scale: float = 1.0,
+    ) -> None:
+        reason = unsupported_reason(markov_w1, markov_w2, num_steps)
+        if reason is not None:
